engagements.title: Our commitments

engagements.item4_title: Clear Distinction Between Wellness and Healthcare

engagements.item5_desc: You are free to practice according to your needs, beliefs and personal boundaries.

faq.title: All your questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Students or instructors, find answers to the most common questions about courses, subscriptions and how the platform works.
faq.q1: How do I access courses on FormationSession?
faq.a1: Create a free account, browse our catalog, and enroll in your course of choice. You will gain instant access from your personal dashboard.
faq.q2: Are courses accessible on mobile devices?
faq.a2: Yes, the platform is fully responsive. You can follow your courses from any device: smartphone, tablet or laptop, at any time.
faq.q3: How can I become an instructor on FormationSession?
faq.a3: Submit your application through the "Become an Instructor" page. Our team reviews your qualifications and experience before approving your courses.
faq.q4: What is the cost for instructors?
faq.a4: Instructors pay a monthly plan to access course creation tools, hosting and publication. This provides all necessary features to manage students.
faq.a5: If you are not satisfied with a course within 7 days of enrollment and have viewed less than 30% of the content, you can request a full refund.
faq.a6: Certain courses provide a certificate of completion issued by the instructor. Certification details are noted on each course page.
faq.q7: Can I interact with my instructor?
faq.a7: Yes. Depending on the course, you can ask questions via comments, attend live sessions, or join a dedicated group.
faq.a8: Every instructor application is thoroughly reviewed by our team. We check credentials, background experience, and the pedagogical quality of the curriculum.
